Recommend
Aug 2025
This Thai restaurant is absolutely fantastic! The flavors are authentic, bold, and perfectly balanced—every dish feels like a trip to Bangkok. Tom Yum is a must-try, with its spicy, tangy broth and fresh shrimp. Pad Thai is equally delicious, with just the right sweetness and texture. Service is quick and friendly, and the ambiance is cozy with subtle Thai-inspired decor. Portions are generous, and prices are reasonable for the quality. Don’t miss their Mango Sticky Rice—it’s the perfect sweet ending! Highly recommend for anyone craving true Thai flavors

Nice and cozy place for fine dining in Hanoi
Jan 2023
We dined at Flamant a couple time, it's located at Xuan Dieu street with a great view over the lake and the city. We had a western tasting menu and every course was delicious. 
We’ve been in Vietnam for 2 weeks and this is the best food we’ve had. The server was attentive and kind, but also left us to enjoy our meal and the view. The food was great and also what i love most is their plentiful cocktails menu. The desert tasted nice also. 
It is a fine-dining restaurant with reasonable price. We would definitely visit this restaurant again.
